notes.title: Good news! New update available!
notes.content:
Knights of the Arena!
We’ve got a number of new functions and changes for you to test out:
- The stats of the Hero’s combat hulls and weapons have been changed
- New card: Scorpion
- New card: Mystic
- New card: Mystic’s Phantoms
- New card: Orbit
- The last time a player signed in is displayed in their profile
- Minor bugfixes and improvements
